name: TextArea: Make "ctrl+s" escape fullscreen
description: Right now when in full-screen on a textarea, I can only exit by pressing "esc". Make it so I can also exit by pressing "ctrl+s" since more users are familiar with that action to save their current work and "esc" feels jarring after you have entered a bunch of text

comments.author: sunny
comments.body: Complexity 2/10. Branch codex/row-23-textarea-ctrl-s from origin/main at 0abb49c. Plan: make ctrl+s close expanded TextArea fields while retaining text, preserve document save behavior, update hints and docs, capture before/after PTY evidence, and run all four required checks. Companion branches inspected; shared guide changes will be reconciled before the PR.

comments.author: sunny
